kinds.label: Customer
kinds.note: Access to a customer covers their payments, invoices and subscriptions. Payments without a customer are covered only by allowing every customer.

kinds.label: Amount
kinds.note: Each refund or credit also needs its amount allowed: allow "Up to" a limit, or a whole currency. Limits apply to each refund or credit on its own; a run makes only a few writes, but separate runs add up. Search for a currency code, such as eur, to see its limits.

auth.label: Restricted API key
auth.hint: Create a restricted key in Stripe (Developers, API keys) with the permissions in Minerva's setup guide. Keys start with rk_live_ or rk_test_.

operations.name: list_customers
operations.title: List customers
operations.description: List the customers you may see, newest first, with their contact details and balance (negative is credit they have, positive is what they owe). To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

email.description: Only customers with exactly this email address. Only one page is returned.
email.title: Email

operations.name: get_customer
operations.title: Get a customer
operations.description: Get one customer: contact details, currency, balance and whether they are delinquent.

customer.description: A customer id from list_customers, such as cus_123.
customer.title: Customer

operations.name: list_payments
operations.title: List payments
operations.description: List payments (charges), newest first: amounts in the currency's usual unit, what was refunded and what is left to refund, status, dispute, card brand and last four digits. Payments without a customer are shown only when every customer may be seen. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

anyOf.description: A customer id from list_customers, such as cus_123.

operations.name: list_invoices
operations.title: List invoices
operations.description: List invoices, newest first, with their status and amounts due, paid and remaining. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

anyOf.description: A customer id from list_customers, such as cus_123.

operations.name: list_subscriptions
operations.title: List subscriptions
operations.description: List subscriptions, newest first, with their status, prices and when the current period ends. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

anyOf.description: A customer id from list_customers, such as cus_123.

status.description: Leave out for every subscription that is not canceled.
status.title: Status

operations.name: refund_payment
operations.title: Refund a payment
operations.description: Refund part or all of a payment to the card or account it came from. Give the amount and the payment's currency; the refund goes through at once, and Stripe reports when it reaches the customer. Disputed payments cannot be refunded.

amount.description: How much to refund, in the currency's usual unit, as a decimal string: 12.50 for 12.50 USD. At most what is left to refund.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: The payment's currency, such as usd.
currency.title: Currency

payment.description: A payment id from list_payments, such as ch_123.
payment.title: Payment

operations.name: credit_customer
operations.title: Credit a customer
operations.description: Add credit to a customer's balance, which Stripe takes off their next invoices. Nothing is paid out, and the customer is not notified. Give the amount in the customer's currency and a description of why.

amount.description: How much to credit, in the currency's usual unit, as a decimal string: 12.50.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: The customer's currency, such as usd. A customer has one currency once billed.
currency.title: Currency

customer.description: A customer id from list_customers, such as cus_123.
customer.title: Customer

description.description: Why the credit is given; the customer may see it.
description.title: Description
